summary: Ran backend pytest regression against preview URL and mobile-first Expo UI validation for updated Course→Subjects→Students flows. Backend critical paths passed end-to-end including reset-all, admin password-protected delete operations, student/admin password changes, notifications, and insights structure. Frontend validated core auth, hidden forgot-password behavior, course/subject creation, student approval, and admin student edit/password change, but full UI completion was blocked by limited selector coverage in chip/list interactions.

minor.issue: Observed KeyError('course_id') in backend logs when legacy/inconsistent subject documents exist; endpoint can return 500 instead of handling malformed records safely.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing testID attributes on interactive chips/rows prevents stable mobile automation for assign/bulk-attendance flows.

ui_bugs.component: Admin password field in Student Management
ui_bugs.issue: Generated selector was unstable for automation; explicit testID needed for reliable delete/password-change verification.

action_items: Add explicit testID to Chip/RoleChip/selectable attendance rows and admin password action input to unblock complete mobile regression automation.
Harden /api/admin/subjects against malformed legacy documents missing course_id (skip/clean invalid docs instead of 500).
Align frontend env contract to include/use EXPO_BACKEND_URL consistently (currently .env and api.ts rely on EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL).

Main agent should manually re-run remaining UI checks after testID updates: assign subject + bulk attendance selection + student self profile/password + admin notifications/insights verification in one pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend still has several interactive elements without explicit testID, reducing test reliability for mobile-first Expo web automation.
backend/server.py get_subjects sorts by item['course_id'] without defensive fallback; malformed existing data can crash endpoint.
Service config deviates from stated EXPO_BACKEND_URL contract by depending on EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in runtime/env.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_* course, subject, student records through backend tests and UI; data retained for follow-up retest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression is green via /app/backend/tests/test_attendance_api.py. UI run reached admin student-edit/password-change but blocked later by missing testIDs for chip/list interactions; use explicit testIDs before retrying full mobile playbook.
rca_of_issue: UI automation failures were primarily selector-level, caused by missing explicit testIDs on dynamic chip/row components and reliance on mutable text labels. Separately, backend logs confirm /api/admin/subjects can fail with KeyError when old subject docs lack course_id, indicating migration/data-shape hardening is needed.
